description: Agronomic guidance database for crop stages, nutrition, and management practices vetted by agricultural universities (UAS Bangalore/Dharwad, ICAR, KVK). Stubs must be authored by certified agronomists and cite authoritative Package of Practices sources.

nursery.advice: Raise seedlings on raised beds with well-decomposed FYM and Trichoderma. Ensure proper drainage.
nursery.source: UAS Dharwad Package of Practices for Vegetable Crops

vegetative.advice: Incorporate well-rotted compost. Apply balanced nutrients according to regional soil test recommendations and university package of practices.
vegetative.source: ICAR-IIHR Package of Practices for Tomato

flowering.advice: Maintain uniform soil moisture. Avoid water-logging. Monitor closely for foliar spots and blossom end rot (calcium balance).
flowering.source: ICAR-IIHR Package of Practices for Tomato

fruiting.advice: Support heavy fruit load with staking. Maintain consistent moisture to prevent fruit cracking.

vegetative.advice: Apply organic manure during bed preparation. Ensure adequate sulfur and potassium per soil health card guidelines.
vegetative.source: ICAR-DOGR Package of Practices for Onion & Garlic

bulb_development.advice: Cease nitrogen applications before bulb maturity. Avoid excessive moisture to prevent bulb rot.
bulb_development.source: ICAR-DOGR Package of Practices for Onion & Garlic

tuber_initiation.advice: Earthing up is essential at 30-35 days to prevent greening of tubers. Maintain cool, moist soil conditions without water accumulation.
